_comment: Copy to app-grant-roles.json (yours: never overwritten) to let workload identities be given more roles than GitOps Manager's list (Storage Blob/Queue Data Reader and Contributor, Key Vault Secrets User, Service Bus Data Sender and Receiver, AcrPull). Each a built-in role name or a role GUID, your own custom roles included. Owner, User Access Administrator and Role Based Access Control Administrator are refused. Applied to a cluster by bootstrap-cluster-identities.yml (identity aso, update mode) or a create.
